campaignsText: Karakurt has conducted numerous campaigns targeting businesses globally, leveraging the infrastructure and reputation of the Conti ransomware group. Their operations demonstrate a focus on maximizing financial gain through data theft, with ransoms ranging from low to high values depending on the victim's perceived ability to pay.
description: Karakurt is a medium-sophistication criminal threat actor assessed with high confidence as the extortion wing of the Conti ransomware group. Specializing in data theft and non-encryption-based extortion, Karakurt operates since December 2022, targeting businesses globally to extract ransoms ranging from $25,000 to $13 million through data auction or publication threats.
goals: Karakurt's primary objectives are organizational gain through financial extortion using stolen data.
